scope.contract: UTF-8 templates, standard scalar formatters and line/record repetition; RFC 4180 quoting and formula-injection protection; SDK, CLI and service via explicit text envelope
Opt-in restart of explicit numId lists per repeated item; preserve original numbering by default

Clone classic footnote/endnote/comment definitions with scoped fields and remap references per item; reject threaded comments; repeated comments and endnotes cannot share a story because of a confirmed LibreOffice rendering defect
Local A1 cell/range references with absolute-row semantics, row insertion/deletion and cache invalidation; reject unsupported reference forms
Text slicing/trimming, numeric INT/MOD/SQRT/POWER and COUNTA/COUNTBLANK with independent expected results
Strict passive SVG subset rasterized to PNG; DOCX inline insertion through explicit image bindings and pixel dimensions
Explicit chart-part data updates for category charts with literal series, preserving chart layout; reject external/embedded workbook-linked updates
Worker Prometheus endpoints, authenticated scraping and documented Prometheus aggregation across processes
Offline snapshot to empty PostgreSQL/S3 target, preserve identities and credentials, verify every blob, atomic metadata commit and rollback

gates: Real PostgreSQL/S3 migration and metrics integration
